label: Azmaveth

text.BHSA 1CH 12:2: נֹ֣שְׁקֵי קֶ֗שֶׁת מַיְמִינִ֤ים וּמַשְׂמִאלִים֙ בָּֽאֲבָנִ֔ים וּבַחִצִּ֖ים בַּקָּ֑שֶׁת מֵאֲחֵ֥י שָׁא֖וּל מִבִּנְיָמִֽן׃
text.KJV 1CH 12:2: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow, even of Saul's brethren of Benjamin.
text.BHSA 1CH 12:3: הָרֹ֨אשׁ אֲחִיעֶ֜זֶר וְיֹואָ֗שׁ בְּנֵי֙ הַשְּׁמָעָ֣ה הַגִּבְעָתִ֔י ויזואל וָפֶ֖לֶט בְּנֵ֣י עַזְמָ֑וֶת וּבְרָכָ֕ה וְיֵה֖וּא הָעֲנְּתֹתִֽי׃
text.KJV 1CH 12:3: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite.
text.BHSA 1CH 12:4: וְוְיִֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֧ה יִרְמְיָ֤ה וְהַיַחֲזִיאֵל֙ גִּבְעֹונִ֛י גִּבֹּ֥ור וְיֹ֣וחָנָ֔ן בַּוְשְּׁלֹשִׁ֖ים יֹוזָבָ֖ד הַוְגְּדֵרָתִֽי׃ עַל־הַשְּׁלֹשִֽׁים׃
text.KJV 1CH 12:4: And Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,

B.name: Azmaveth
B.line: Benjamite, father of Jeziel and Pelet who joined David at Ziklag

why: בְּנֵי עַזְמָוֶת identifies Azmaveth as Jeziel and Pelet’s father among the Benjamite warriors, matching B’s stated setting with David. A also claims those sons, however, and the passage does not name Azmaveth’s father, so the supplied text cannot conclusively distinguish the records.
